task_prompt: Put the plushie into the grey box.
task_summary: The left hand pulls the grey drawer open by its handle, picks up the small yellow plush toy, drops it into the open drawer, and pushes the drawer closed; the right hand rests on the table throughout.

environment.camera: head-mounted egocentric camera looking down over the table; small head motion only

hands.notes: The right hand stays flat on the table at the lower right for the whole clip.

objects.name: grey drawer box

appearance.housing: grey plastic, rectangular, lid closed on top
appearance.front_handle: black recessed pull handle centred on the front panel

objects.approximate_size: about three hand-lengths deep and a hand-span wide; taller than the toy
properties: The prompt's 'grey box' is a single-drawer unit: the front panel with the handle is the face of a tray that slides out of the housing toward the operator.
One prismatic joint connects the tray to the housing; the tray translates along the housing's long axis, outward to open and inward to close, with no rotation or sideways play.
The observed travel is roughly one housing length, enough to expose the whole tray interior from above.
The handle is grasped from above with the fingers hooked behind it to pull, and pushed with the palm or fingers to close.
The tray interior is an open cavity that can receive and hold the toy; the housing stays put on the table while the tray moves.

articulation.axis: along the housing's long axis, toward the operator (down and left in the image)
articulation.range_observed: closed to about one housing length open
articulation.state_over_video: closed -> open (2.6 s to 5 s) -> stays open while the toy goes in -> closed (9.5 s to 11.5 s)

objects.initial_state: closed, standing at the far left of the table with the handle facing the operator
objects.final_state: closed again, in the same place, with the toy inside
objects.evidence: prompt: 'grey box'; frames 0 to 2.6 s show a closed grey box; 2.6 to 5 s the front panel slides toward the operator revealing a tray; 9.5 to 11.5 s it slides back.

objects.name: small yellow plush toy

appearance.body: pale yellow fluffy plush with small dark markings

properties: Soft, light and compliant: it is picked up with a whole-hand grasp from above and squashes slightly in the hand.
It can be carried in one hand and released from above the tray to drop and come to rest inside.
Its shape does not matter for the task beyond fitting through the tray opening; it may be reconstructed as a soft or rigid body of roughly the right size.

deformation.how_the_task_deforms_it: squeezed in the grasp; otherwise carried whole

objects.initial_state: lying on the table to the right of the drawer unit
objects.final_state: inside the tray, enclosed when the drawer closes
objects.evidence: prompt: 'plushie'; 6 to 7.5 s the left hand lifts it off the cloth; 7.5 to 8.8 s it is carried over the open tray and dropped in.

subgoals.action: Pull the drawer open by its front handle.

hand_roles.left: Hooks the fingers behind the handle and pulls the tray toward the operator.
Closes around the toy from above and lifts it clear of the cloth.

subgoals.goal: The toy is held in the left hand, clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry the toy over the open tray.

hand_roles.left: Moves the held toy to above the tray opening.

subgoals.goal: The toy is above the sliding tray's interior.

subgoals.action: Release the toy into the tray.

hand_roles.left: Opens the hand so the toy drops into the tray, then withdraws.

subgoals.goal: The toy rests inside the sliding tray without hand support.

hand_roles.left: Pushes on the front panel until the tray is back inside the housing.

subgoals.goal: The toy is inside the sliding tray, the sliding tray is fully closed and its interior is hidden.

task_success: The drawer is closed and in its original place, with the plush toy inside it.
notes: Only the left hand acts in this demonstration, although the drawer is on the left and the toy on the right.
